question: I'm an IS senior with an ISP concentration and a History minor. I've completed 46 courses. Given that I need 360 units to graduate, am I likely to have enough units from my 46 completed courses?
expected_answer: At 46 completed courses, P-020 is likely close to the 360-unit threshold. The average course at CMU-Q is 9–12 units. If the average is approximately 9–10 units per course, 46 courses would yield approximately 414–460 units — potentially well above 360. However, some courses may be mini-courses (3–6 units) or the count may include P/N courses that count toward units but need verification. P-020 should verify total passed units in S3 or Stellic.
reasoning_type: Unit accumulation estimation and threshold reasoning
common_mistake: Assuming course count directly maps to unit count without considering variable unit courses; not distinguishing 'passed units' (counting toward graduation) from total enrolled units
needs_verification: Retrieve P-020's actual total passed units from S3/Stellic
Confirm the 360-unit graduation requirement for IS at CMU-Q
Confirm that all 46 of P-020's courses are counted as 'passed units' (not failed or W)
